sentences.text:
The Revision was filed against the concurrent conviction for the alleged offence under Section 7(5)
of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

Sri Praveen Kumar, learned Counsel representing Sri Nimmagadda Satyanarayana, for the Petitioners submits that the Revisionist by name Maddali Sreenivasarao has expired and to that effect he filed photocopy of the death certificate in which it is mentioned that Maddali Sreenivasarao died on 21.09.2010.
Learned Counsel for the Petitioners requested to dismiss the revision as abated.
Ms. Akhila, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor also confirmed the same.
Recording the said submissions, this Criminal Revision Case is dismissed as abated.
As a sequel, interlocutory applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.

Dr. Y. LAKSHMANA RAO, J Dt: 06.03.2025 VTS Maddali Sreenivasarao And Another, vs State Of A.P., Rep By Pp., on 6 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159129656/
